description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: focused PR6 test suites above and docs/services/agent.md, materialization.md and channels.md only where their contracts changed; keep docs index consistent if navigation changes. Reconcile reference scenarios with revised accepted architecture, documenting source-parity exceptions: no Outgoing.Delivery, flat identity, destination preflight/filtering, sticky failure state, file-failure notice path or PR7 consumers. No new feature implementation is hidden in this acceptance step.
Tests to add before implementation: finalize any missing immediate unit/integration/property regression identified by the acceptance matrix before corresponding code. Acceptance matrix links: provenance tamper/old-token reissue -> task .2; schema/current authorization/selection reducer -> .3; aliases/scope -> .4; ordering/replay/terminal cleanup -> .5; configured Agent success/error propagation -> .6; real PR5 transport -> .7. Run existing Record/Authorization/Materialization/TrustedContext/Registry/Factory/StreamEvents/Executor/Agent API/Outgoing and relevant delivery suites after affected work. Verify boundaries, output privacy and test isolation as well as successful paths.
Branches/paths validated: every epic acceptance point, nil identity/explicit privilege negatives, concurrent/interrupted runtime, same-server next request, no incoming echo, no file I/O at selection time, no PR5/PR7 ownership drift. Existing assertion changes require disclosed approval; never port obsolete reference expectations into new-branch tests.
Mocking plan: internal boundaries real and edge stubs only; audit unique database/runtime/alias scopes and absence of application-global mutation. No new seam solely to mirror implementation.
Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content: module public schemas/lifecycle contracts and relevant owning guides; concise token reissue/selection versus delivery explanation; verify paths and examples. Beadwork retains progress and scope decisions, not new docs/exec-plans files.
Action reuse assessment: verify recorded new Action/reuse/extend/local-only decisions against final source and tests; no additional application operation. Require source evidence that GetDocument/Authorization, schema alias traversal, native reducer, canonical builder and PR5 delivery are actually shared. Documentation-only edits themselves are not Action candidates. Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md issue validation; this task is not the final precommit gate.

Approved acceptance matrix: disk and Google Drive x Mattermost, email, BO chat and widget (eight source/destination combinations). For each verify selected files and bytes/filename, current authorization, limits and failure reporting. Browser destinations additionally verify session expiry/revocation, cross-user/config isolation, history reload and no leaked handles. Record actual configured Mattermost/SMTP/Drive smoke evidence separately from deterministic fixtures; unavailable environment is an explicit unresolved acceptance prerequisite. Require compatible published package revisions before claiming deployed readiness.

E2E is required for the expanded browser scope. Dedicated human UX approval zaq-pi3.17 precedes consolidated E2E zaq-pi3.18. This task completes immediate integration acceptance and docs, not final feature closure. Update docs/services/web-bridge.md and widget package docs as applicable.

Implementation handoff: Scope and sequence approved by the user on 2026-11-28. This turn records the plan only; application implementation, commits, pushes, rebases and dependency publication are not performed or authorized by this planning update. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/documentation.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md before execution. Read applicable service guides and module responsibilities; Agent work requires the harness-critical checks; BO work requires DESIGN.md and docs/bo-components.md. Recheck live source and dependency contracts. Preserve existing test behavior unless specifically approved. Write immediate unit/integration/property tests before corresponding code; new browser journeys wait for the human UX gate. Keep real internal boundaries, mock only external edges, and inject runtime dependencies through existing opts/context and Zaq.Config. Follow the owning validation lifecycle. PR7 owns RunAgent, NotifyPerson and notification/workflow integration.
title: [zaq-pi3.8] Validate PR6 acceptance and update owning documentation
